as_told.title: Leaked Kit Green / Kit Randall May phone call about testing experiencers and 'hybrids'

plain: There is said to be a leaked phone call in which Kit Green, a former CIA scientist, and a man named K. Randall May talk about testing contactees, meaning people who say they have been contacted by non-human beings. The whistleblower Dylan Borland tells Michels the most about it. He dates the call to 2017 and says the two men are "literally saying we are testing veterans, military, government officials who have had experiences and in their own words, hybrids." Borland also brings in the psychic Uri Geller. Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who calls himself a whistleblower, also points to "that leaked phone call between Kit Green and" May on the show, but he gives no details. If the call is what Borland says, then people tied to the government were quietly studying insiders who claim contact and calling them hybrids, part human and part something else.
